body.heading: Where in the world is Dominica?
paragraphs: Dominica is a country in Caribbean, which is part of North America. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Dominica is Roseau.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Dominica is English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Dominica is the East Caribbean dollar.

body.heading: How big is Dominica?
paragraphs: Dominica covers about 751 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Dominica, the Nature Island, hides a flooded fumarole lake that actually boils, plus the twin Trafalgar Falls in its UNESCO-listed rainforest park.
At Champagne Reef, volcanic bubbles fizz up through the snorkelling water like a glass of soda — warm, bubbly and full of seahorses.
